```{r rainfall-fraction-thresholds-4}
# =============================================================================
# B2 Boundary Adjustment — ROS Class Recovery
#
# B1 (snowmelt/ROS) fixed: log10(SWE+1) = 0.4973 + 5.3433 * rain_frac
# B2 intercept scaled by k: rain_frac = (0.1078 * k) + 0.3503 * log10(SWE+1)
#
# k=1.0 is the original GMM boundary. Increasing k shifts B2 toward higher
# rain fraction, making it easier for events to be classified as ROS rather
# than rainfall. B1 is held fixed throughout.
#
# Target: smallest k producing >= 20 sites with >= 20 ROS events AND
#         >= 20 sites with >= 20 snowmelt events.
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# Pin commonly masked functions
map     <- purrr::map
map_dfr <- purrr::map_dfr

# --- Paths -------------------------------------------------------------------
proj_root <- "/Users/mtalbot/Desktop/GitHub/CoWC_FY26_Enhanced_Impacts/"
data_dir  <- file.path(proj_root, "_data")
diag_dir  <- file.path(proj_root, "_diagnostics", "threshold_evaluation",
                       "gmm_rain_frac_swe", "boundary_adjustment")
dir.create(diag_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Constants ---------------------------------------------------------------
SWE_LOG_OFFSET <- 1.0
MIN_VIABLE     <- 20   # minimum sites with >= 20 events for FFA viability

# B1 coefficients (fixed)
B1_INTERCEPT <- 0.4973
B1_SLOPE     <- 5.3433

# B2 base coefficients (intercept scaled by k)
B2_INTERCEPT_BASE <- 0.1078
B2_SLOPE          <- 0.3503

# --- Load data ---------------------------------------------------------------
adaptive <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "pot_peaks_classified_adaptive.rds"))
meta     <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "site_metadata.rds"))

unreg_sites <- meta %>% filter(!regulated) %>% pull(site_no)

peaks <- adaptive %>%
  distinct(site_no, peak_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(site_no %in% unreg_sites,
         !is.na(rain_frac), !is.na(swe_mean_mm)) %>%
  mutate(log10_swe = log10(swe_mean_mm + SWE_LOG_OFFSET)) %>%
  dplyr::select(site_no, peak_id, rain_frac, swe_mean_mm, log10_swe)

cat(sprintf("Peaks available: %d across %d sites\n",
            nrow(peaks), n_distinct(peaks$site_no)))

# --- Old scheme counts for reference -----------------------------------------
old_counts <- peaks %>%
  left_join(adaptive %>% dplyr::select(site_no, peak_id, rain_frac),
            by = c("site_no", "peak_id", "rain_frac")) %>%
  mutate(old_class = case_when(
    rain_frac >= 0.95 ~ "rainfall",
    rain_frac <= 0.10 ~ "snowmelt",
    TRUE              ~ "ROS"
  ))

old_total <- old_counts %>%
  dplyr::count(old_class) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = old_class, values_from = n)

old_viability <- old_counts %>%
  dplyr::count(site_no, old_class) %>%
  group_by(old_class) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites_above_20 = sum(n >= MIN_VIABLE),
    median_n         = median(n),
    .groups          = "drop"
  )

cat("\nOld 0.10/0.95 scheme — total counts:\n")
print(old_total)
cat("\nOld 0.10/0.95 scheme — viability:\n")
print(old_viability)

# --- Classify under a given k ------------------------------------------------
classify_k <- function(df, k) {
  b2_int_k <- B2_INTERCEPT_BASE * k
  df %>%
    mutate(
      log10_swe_b1 = B1_INTERCEPT + B1_SLOPE * rain_frac,
      rain_frac_b2 = b2_int_k     + B2_SLOPE  * log10_swe,
      class_k = case_when(
        log10_swe > log10_swe_b1 ~ "snowmelt",
        rain_frac < rain_frac_b2 ~ "ROS",
        TRUE                     ~ "rainfall"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-log10_swe_b1, -rain_frac_b2)
}

# --- Grid search over k ------------------------------------------------------
k_seq <- seq(1.0, 5.0, by = 0.1)

results <- purrr::map_dfr(k_seq, function(k) {
  cl <- classify_k(peaks, k)

  totals <- cl %>%
    dplyr::count(class_k) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class_k, values_from = n,
                       values_fill = 0L)

  viability <- cl %>%
    dplyr::count(site_no, class_k) %>%
    group_by(class_k) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sites_above_20 = sum(n >= MIN_VIABLE),
      median_n         = median(n),
      .groups          = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = class_k,
      values_from = c(n_sites_above_20, median_n),
      names_glue  = "{.value}_{class_k}"
    )

  tibble(k = k) %>%
    bind_cols(totals) %>%
    bind_cols(viability)
})

# --- Find target k -----------------------------------------------------------
target_k_row <- results %>%
  filter(
    n_sites_above_20_ROS      >= MIN_VIABLE,
    n_sites_above_20_snowmelt >= MIN_VIABLE
  ) %>%
  slice_min(k, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

if (nrow(target_k_row) == 0) {
  cat("\nWARNING: No k in [1.0, 5.0] satisfies both viability criteria.\n")
  cat("Reporting k with maximum ROS viability instead.\n")
  target_k_row <- results %>% slice_max(n_sites_above_20_ROS, n = 1,
                                         with_ties = FALSE)
}

target_k    <- target_k_row$k
b2_int_k    <- B2_INTERCEPT_BASE * target_k

cat(sprintf(
  "\nTarget k: %.1f\n  B2(k): rain_frac = %.4f + %.4f * log10(SWE+1)\n",
  target_k, b2_int_k, B2_SLOPE
))

# Summary table: k=1.0, target k, old scheme
summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
  results %>% filter(k == 1.0) %>%
    mutate(scheme = "GMM k=1.0 (original)"),
  target_k_row %>%
    mutate(scheme = sprintf("GMM k=%.1f (target)", target_k)),
  tibble(
    k                         = NA_real_,
    rainfall                  = old_total$rainfall,
    snowmelt                  = old_total$snowmelt,
    ROS                       = old_total$ROS,
    n_sites_above_20_rainfall = old_viability$n_sites_above_20[old_viability$old_class == "rainfall"],
    n_sites_above_20_snowmelt = old_viability$n_sites_above_20[old_viability$old_class == "snowmelt"],
    n_sites_above_20_ROS      = old_viability$n_sites_above_20[old_viability$old_class == "ROS"],
    median_n_rainfall         = old_viability$median_n[old_viability$old_class == "rainfall"],
    median_n_snowmelt         = old_viability$median_n[old_viability$old_class == "snowmelt"],
    median_n_ROS              = old_viability$median_n[old_viability$old_class == "ROS"],
    scheme                    = "Old 0.10/0.95"
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::select(scheme, k, rainfall, snowmelt, ROS,
                n_sites_above_20_rainfall, n_sites_above_20_snowmelt,
                n_sites_above_20_ROS,
                median_n_rainfall, median_n_snowmelt, median_n_ROS)

cat("\nComparison summary:\n")
print(summary_tbl, width = Inf)

# --- Shared theme ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

shared_k_x <- list(
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 5, 0.5)),
  labs(x = "Intercept multiplier k")
)

k1_vline <- geom_vline(xintercept = 1.0, linetype = "dashed",
                       color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.45)
kt_vline <- geom_vline(xintercept = target_k, linetype = "solid",
                       color = "black", linewidth = 0.7)
kt_label <- annotate("text", x = target_k, y = Inf,
                     label = sprintf("k=%.1f", target_k),
                     hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.8, color = "black")
k1_label <- annotate("text", x = 1.0, y = Inf,
                     label = "k=1.0\n(orig.)",
                     hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.4, color = "grey50")

# --- Figure 1: Site viability vs. k ------------------------------------------
viability_long <- results %>%
  dplyr::select(k, rainfall = n_sites_above_20_rainfall,
                snowmelt = n_sites_above_20_snowmelt,
                ROS      = n_sites_above_20_ROS) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-k, names_to = "class", values_to = "n_sites")

class_colors <- c("rainfall" = "#E07B39", "ROS" = "#6A9E6F",
                  "snowmelt" = "#5B8DB8")

p_viability <- ggplot(viability_long, aes(x = k, y = n_sites, color = class)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = MIN_VIABLE, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 5.0, y = MIN_VIABLE,
           label = sprintf("Min viable (%d)", MIN_VIABLE),
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.6, color = "black") +
  k1_vline + kt_vline + kt_label + k1_label +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, name = NULL) +
  shared_k_x +
  labs(
    title    = "Sites with >= 20 events per class vs. k",
    subtitle = sprintf("Target k=%.1f: first k where both ROS and snowmelt >= %d sites",
                       target_k, MIN_VIABLE),
    y        = sprintf("Sites with >= %d events", MIN_VIABLE)
  ) +
  diag_theme

# --- Figure 2: Total class counts vs. k --------------------------------------
counts_long <- results %>%
  dplyr::select(k, rainfall, snowmelt, ROS) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-k, names_to = "class", values_to = "count")

old_ref <- tibble(
  class = c("rainfall", "snowmelt", "ROS"),
  ref   = c(as.integer(old_total$rainfall),
            as.integer(old_total$snowmelt),
            as.integer(old_total$ROS))
)

p_counts <- ggplot(counts_long, aes(x = k, y = count, color = class)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(data = old_ref, aes(yintercept = ref, color = class),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.45) +
  k1_vline + kt_vline + kt_label + k1_label +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, name = NULL) +
  shared_k_x +
  labs(
    title    = "Total event counts per class vs. k",
    subtitle = "Dashed horizontals = old 0.10/0.95 scheme counts",
    y        = "Total events"
  ) +
  diag_theme

# --- Figure 3: Classification space at target k ------------------------------
peaks_target <- classify_k(
  adaptive %>%
    distinct(site_no, peak_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    filter(site_no %in% unreg_sites,
           !is.na(rain_frac), !is.na(swe_mean_mm)) %>%
    mutate(log10_swe = log10(swe_mean_mm + SWE_LOG_OFFSET)),
  k = target_k
)

# B1 and B2(k) boundary lines
rf_seq  <- seq(0, 1,    length.out = 500)
swe_seq <- seq(-0.5, 3, length.out = 500)

bnd1_plot <- tibble(
  rain_frac = rf_seq,
  swe_mm    = 10^(B1_INTERCEPT + B1_SLOPE * rf_seq) - SWE_LOG_OFFSET,
  boundary  = "B1: Snowmelt/ROS"
) %>% filter(swe_mm > 0)

bnd2_plot <- tibble(
  log10_swe = swe_seq,
  rain_frac = (B2_INTERCEPT_BASE * target_k) + B2_SLOPE * swe_seq,
  swe_mm    = 10^swe_seq - SWE_LOG_OFFSET,
  boundary  = sprintf("B2(k=%.1f): ROS/Rainfall", target_k)
) %>% filter(swe_mm > 0, rain_frac >= 0, rain_frac <= 1)

bnd2_orig <- tibble(
  log10_swe = swe_seq,
  rain_frac = B2_INTERCEPT_BASE + B2_SLOPE * swe_seq,
  swe_mm    = 10^swe_seq - SWE_LOG_OFFSET,
  boundary  = "B2(k=1.0): original"
) %>% filter(swe_mm > 0, rain_frac >= 0, rain_frac <= 1)

bnd_lines <- bind_rows(bnd1_plot, bnd2_plot, bnd2_orig)

p_classspace <- ggplot(
  peaks_target,
  aes(x = rain_frac, y = swe_mean_mm + SWE_LOG_OFFSET, color = class_k)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.20, size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = bnd_lines,
            aes(x = rain_frac, y = swe_mm + SWE_LOG_OFFSET,
                linetype = boundary),
            color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Class") +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("B1: Snowmelt/ROS"                       = "solid",
               sprintf("B2(k=%.1f): ROS/Rainfall", target_k) = "dashed",
               "B2(k=1.0): original"                    = "dotted"),
    name = "Boundary"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Classification space at target k=%.1f", target_k),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "B2(k=%.1f): rain_frac = %.4f + %.4f * log10(SWE+1)",
      target_k, B2_INTERCEPT_BASE * target_k, B2_SLOPE
    ),
    x = "Rain fraction",
    y = "Mean antecedent SWE + 1 (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# --- Figure 4: Per-site ROS count distribution -------------------------------
ros_target <- classify_k(peaks, target_k) %>%
  filter(class_k == "ROS") %>%
  dplyr::count(site_no) %>%
  mutate(scheme = sprintf("GMM k=%.1f", target_k))

ros_old <- old_counts %>%
  filter(old_class == "ROS") %>%
  dplyr::count(site_no) %>%
  mutate(scheme = "Old 0.10/0.95")

ros_both <- bind_rows(ros_target, ros_old) %>%
  mutate(scheme = factor(scheme, levels = c("Old 0.10/0.95",
                                             sprintf("GMM k=%.1f", target_k))))

p_ros_dist <- ggplot(ros_both, aes(x = n, fill = scheme)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, alpha = 0.55, position = "identity",
                 color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = MIN_VIABLE, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = MIN_VIABLE, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Min viable\n(%d)", MIN_VIABLE),
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Old 0.10/0.95" = "grey60",
               sprintf("GMM k=%.1f", target_k) = "#6A9E6F"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Per-site ROS event count distribution",
    subtitle = sprintf("Target k=%.1f vs. old 0.10/0.95 scheme", target_k),
    x        = "ROS events per site",
    y        = "Number of sites"
  ) +
  diag_theme

# --- Save --------------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "viability_vs_k.png"),
       plot = p_viability,  width = 8,   height = 5,   dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "counts_vs_k.png"),
       plot = p_counts,     width = 8,   height = 5,   dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "classspace_target_k.png"),
       plot = p_classspace, width = 7,   height = 5.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "ros_site_distribution.png"),

fig_combined <- (p_viability + p_counts) / (p_classspace + p_ros_dist) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = sprintf("B2 boundary adjustment — ROS class recovery (target k=%.1f)", target_k),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "B1 fixed: log10(SWE+1) = %.4f + %.4f*rf  |  B2(k): rf = %.4f + %.4f*log10(SWE+1)",
      B1_INTERCEPT, B1_SLOPE, B2_INTERCEPT_BASE * target_k, B2_SLOPE
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,  color = "grey40")

ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "boundary_adjustment.png"),
```

```{r rainfall-fraction-thresholds-5}
# =============================================================================
# Equal-N Boundary Evaluation
#
# Tests whether dividing rain_frac into three equal thirds produces
# physically reasonable boundaries — i.e., whether the 33rd and 67th
# percentiles fall in the sparse middle region of the bimodal distribution
# rather than cutting through either end-member mode.
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# --- Paths -------------------------------------------------------------------
proj_root <- "/Users/mtalbot/Desktop/GitHub/CoWC_FY26_Enhanced_Impacts/"
data_dir  <- file.path(proj_root, "_data")
diag_dir  <- file.path(proj_root, "_diagnostics", "threshold_evaluation",
                       "equal_n_boundaries")
dir.create(diag_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Constants ---------------------------------------------------------------
MIN_VIABLE     <- 20
SWE_LOG_OFFSET <- 1.0
B1_INTERCEPT   <- 0.4973   # GMM snowmelt/ROS boundary (fixed)
B1_SLOPE       <- 5.3433

# Old scalar thresholds for comparison
OLD_SNOW_THRESH <- 0.10
OLD_RAIN_THRESH <- 0.95

# --- Load data ---------------------------------------------------------------
adaptive <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "pot_peaks_classified_adaptive.rds"))
meta     <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "site_metadata.rds"))

unreg_sites <- meta %>% filter(!regulated) %>% pull(site_no)

peaks <- adaptive %>%
  distinct(site_no, peak_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(site_no %in% unreg_sites, !is.na(rain_frac)) %>%
  mutate(
    log10_swe = log10(coalesce(swe_mean_mm, 0) + SWE_LOG_OFFSET)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(site_no, peak_id, rain_frac, swe_mean_mm, log10_swe)

cat(sprintf("Peaks available: %d across %d sites\n",
            nrow(peaks), n_distinct(peaks$site_no)))

# --- Equal-n boundary identification -----------------------------------------
lower_bnd <- quantile(peaks$rain_frac, 1/3)
upper_bnd <- quantile(peaks$rain_frac, 2/3)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nEqual-n boundaries:\n  Lower (33rd pct): %.4f\n  Upper (67th pct): %.4f\n",
  lower_bnd, upper_bnd
))

# Flag whether boundaries fall in sparse middle or cut through a mode
# Estimate local density at each boundary
dens       <- density(peaks$rain_frac, from = 0, to = 1, n = 1000)
dens_df    <- tibble(x = dens$x, y = dens$y)
dens_lower <- dens_df$y[which.min(abs(dens_df$x - lower_bnd))]
dens_upper <- dens_df$y[which.min(abs(dens_df$x - upper_bnd))]
dens_max   <- max(dens_df$y)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nDensity at boundaries (relative to max density = 1.0):\n  Lower boundary (%.4f): %.3f\n  Upper boundary (%.4f): %.3f\n",
  lower_bnd, dens_lower / dens_max,
  upper_bnd, dens_upper / dens_max
))

if (dens_lower / dens_max < 0.3 && dens_upper / dens_max < 0.3) {
  cat("ASSESSMENT: Both boundaries fall in sparse region — physically reasonable.\n")
} else if (dens_lower / dens_max >= 0.3 && dens_upper / dens_max >= 0.3) {
  cat("ASSESSMENT: Both boundaries cut through dense regions — NOT physically reasonable.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf(
    "ASSESSMENT: Mixed — lower boundary %s, upper boundary %s.\n",
    if (dens_lower / dens_max < 0.3) "sparse (OK)" else "dense (problematic)",
    if (dens_upper / dens_max < 0.3) "sparse (OK)" else "dense (problematic)"
  ))
}

# --- Apply equal-n classification --------------------------------------------
peaks <- peaks %>%
  mutate(
    class_equaln = case_when(
      rain_frac <= lower_bnd ~ "snowmelt",
      rain_frac >= upper_bnd ~ "rainfall",
      TRUE                   ~ "ROS"
    )
  )

# --- Viability: equal-n ------------------------------------------------------
equaln_total <- peaks %>%
  dplyr::count(class_equaln) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class_equaln, values_from = n,
                     values_fill = 0L)

equaln_viability <- peaks %>%
  dplyr::count(site_no, class_equaln) %>%
  group_by(class_equaln) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites_above_20 = sum(n >= MIN_VIABLE),
    median_n         = median(n),
    .groups          = "drop"
  )

cat("\nEqual-n classification — total counts:\n")
print(equaln_total)
cat("\nEqual-n classification — viability:\n")
print(equaln_viability)

# --- Viability: old scheme ---------------------------------------------------
old_counts <- peaks %>%
  mutate(class_old = case_when(
    rain_frac >= OLD_RAIN_THRESH ~ "rainfall",
    rain_frac <= OLD_SNOW_THRESH ~ "snowmelt",
    TRUE                        ~ "ROS"
  ))

old_total <- old_counts %>%
  dplyr::count(class_old) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class_old, values_from = n,
                     values_fill = 0L)

old_viability <- old_counts %>%
  dplyr::count(site_no, class_old) %>%
  group_by(class_old) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites_above_20 = sum(n >= MIN_VIABLE),
    median_n         = median(n),
    .groups          = "drop"
  )

cat("\nOld 0.10/0.95 scheme — total counts:\n")
print(old_total)
cat("\nOld 0.10/0.95 scheme — viability:\n")
print(old_viability)

# --- Colours -----------------------------------------------------------------
class_colors <- c("rainfall" = "#E07B39", "ROS" = "#6A9E6F",
                  "snowmelt" = "#5B8DB8")

diag_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# --- Figure 1: Rain fraction distribution with boundaries --------------------
n_total  <- nrow(peaks)
n_snow   <- sum(peaks$class_equaln == "snowmelt")
n_ros    <- sum(peaks$class_equaln == "ROS")
n_rain   <- sum(peaks$class_equaln == "rainfall")

p_dist <- ggplot(peaks, aes(x = rain_frac)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.45,
                 color = "steelblue4", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # Equal-n boundaries
  geom_vline(xintercept = lower_bnd, color = "black",
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = upper_bnd, color = "black",
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Old boundaries
  geom_vline(xintercept = OLD_SNOW_THRESH, color = "grey50",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = OLD_RAIN_THRESH, color = "grey50",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Zone fraction labels
  annotate("text", x = lower_bnd / 2, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Snowmelt\n%.1f%%", 100 * n_snow / n_total),
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1.3, size = 3, color = "#5B8DB8") +
  annotate("text", x = (lower_bnd + upper_bnd) / 2, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("ROS\n%.1f%%", 100 * n_ros / n_total),
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1.3, size = 3, color = "#6A9E6F") +
  annotate("text", x = (upper_bnd + 1) / 2, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Rainfall\n%.1f%%", 100 * n_rain / n_total),
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1.3, size = 3, color = "#E07B39") +
  # Boundary labels
  annotate("text", x = lower_bnd, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Equal-n\n%.3f", lower_bnd),
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 2.8, size = 2.6, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = upper_bnd, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Equal-n\n%.3f", upper_bnd),
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 2.8, size = 2.6, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = OLD_SNOW_THRESH, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Old\n%.2f", OLD_SNOW_THRESH),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2.8, size = 2.4, color = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = OLD_RAIN_THRESH, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Old\n%.2f", OLD_RAIN_THRESH),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2.8, size = 2.4, color = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Rain fraction distribution with equal-n and reference boundaries",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Equal-n: lower=%.4f, upper=%.4f | Density at boundaries: %.3f, %.3f (relative to max)",
      lower_bnd, upper_bnd,
      dens_lower / dens_max, dens_upper / dens_max
    ),
    x = "Rain fraction",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  diag_theme

# --- Figure 2: rain_frac x SWE scatterplot with equal-n boundaries ----------
# B1 GMM snowmelt/ROS boundary line for overlay
rf_seq  <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 500)
bnd1_df <- tibble(
  rain_frac = rf_seq,
  swe_mm    = 10^(B1_INTERCEPT + B1_SLOPE * rf_seq) - SWE_LOG_OFFSET
) %>% filter(swe_mm > 0)

peaks_swe <- peaks %>% filter(!is.na(swe_mean_mm))

p_swe <- ggplot(peaks_swe,
                aes(x = rain_frac,
                    y = swe_mean_mm + SWE_LOG_OFFSET,
                    color = class_equaln)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.20, size = 0.7) +
  # Equal-n vertical boundaries
  geom_vline(xintercept = lower_bnd, color = "black",
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = upper_bnd, color = "black",
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.7) +
  # GMM B1 boundary
  geom_line(data = bnd1_df,
            aes(x = rain_frac, y = swe_mm + SWE_LOG_OFFSET),
            color = "grey30", linetype = "dashed",
            linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = Inf,
           label = "GMM B1\n(snowmelt/ROS)",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.4, color = "grey30") +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Equal-n class") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  labs(
    title    = "rain_frac x SWE under equal-n classification",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Vertical lines = equal-n boundaries (%.4f, %.4f); dashed = GMM B1",
      lower_bnd, upper_bnd
    ),
    x = "Rain fraction",
    y = "Mean antecedent SWE + 1 (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# --- Figure 3: Per-site sample size distributions ----------------------------
site_counts_equaln <- peaks %>%
  dplyr::count(site_no, class_equaln) %>%
  rename(class = class_equaln) %>%
  mutate(scheme = "Equal-n")

site_counts_old <- old_counts %>%
  dplyr::count(site_no, class_old) %>%
  rename(class = class_old) %>%
  mutate(scheme = "Old 0.10/0.95")

site_counts_both <- bind_rows(site_counts_equaln, site_counts_old) %>%
  mutate(
    scheme = factor(scheme, levels = c("Old 0.10/0.95", "Equal-n")),
    class  = factor(class,  levels = c("rainfall", "ROS", "snowmelt"))
  )

p_sites <- ggplot(site_counts_both,
                  aes(x = n, fill = scheme)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, alpha = 0.55, position = "identity",
                 color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = MIN_VIABLE, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ class, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Old 0.10/0.95" = "grey60", "Equal-n" = "steelblue"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Per-site event count distributions by class",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line = MIN_VIABLE (%d events)", MIN_VIABLE),
    x        = "Events per site",
    y        = "Number of sites"
  ) +
  diag_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# --- Save --------------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "rain_frac_distribution.png"),
       plot = p_dist,  width = 9,   height = 5,   dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "rain_frac_swe_equaln.png"),
       plot = p_swe,   width = 7,   height = 5.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "site_sample_sizes.png"),
       plot = p_sites, width = 10,  height = 4.5, dpi = 150)

fig_combined <- (p_dist + p_swe) / p_sites +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Equal-n boundary evaluation",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Lower boundary: %.4f (33rd pct) | Upper boundary: %.4f (67th pct) | Density at boundaries: %.3f, %.3f (rel. to max)",
      lower_bnd, upper_bnd,
      dens_lower / dens_max, dens_upper / dens_max
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,  color = "grey40")
    )
  )

ggsave(file.path(diag_dir, "equal_n_evaluation.png"),
       plot = fig_combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 150)

fig_combined
```

```{r rainfall-fraction-thresholds-6}
# =============================================================================
# Rain Fraction Threshold Justification — Publication Figure
#
# Clean single-panel density plot of rain_frac across all data-sufficient
# POT peaks at unregulated sites, with vertical lines at the snowmelt (0.10)
# and rainfall (0.95) end-member thresholds and shaded candidate zones.
#
# Output:
#   _documentation/classification_decisions/rain_frac_threshold_justification.png
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)

# --- Paths -------------------------------------------------------------------
proj_root <- "/Users/mtalbot/Desktop/GitHub/CoWC_FY26_Enhanced_Impacts/"
data_dir  <- file.path(proj_root, "_data")
out_dir   <- file.path(proj_root, "_documentation", "classification_decisions")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Constants ---------------------------------------------------------------
SNOW_EM_THRESH <- 0.10
RAIN_EM_THRESH <- 0.95

# Candidate zone bounds (shaded regions around each threshold)
SNOW_ZONE_MAX <- 0.20   # shade from 0 to this on the snowmelt side
RAIN_ZONE_MIN <- 0.70   # shade from this to 1 on the rainfall side

# --- Load data ---------------------------------------------------------------
adaptive <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "pot_peaks_classified_adaptive.rds"))
meta     <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "site_metadata.rds"))

unreg_sites <- meta %>% filter(!regulated) %>% pull(site_no)

peaks <- adaptive %>%
  distinct(site_no, peak_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(
    site_no %in% unreg_sites,
    !is.na(rain_frac),
    flood_type_raw != "unclassified"
  )

n_peaks <- nrow(peaks)
n_sites <- n_distinct(peaks$site_no)

cat(sprintf("Peaks included: %d across %d unregulated sites\n",
            n_peaks, n_sites))

# --- Figure ------------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(peaks, aes(x = rain_frac)) +
  # Shaded candidate zones
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = 0,             xmax = SNOW_ZONE_MAX,
           ymin = -Inf,          ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey85",      alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = RAIN_ZONE_MIN, xmax = 1,
           ymin = -Inf,          ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey85",      alpha = 0.7) +
  # Density curve
  geom_density(fill  = "#c0392b", alpha = 0.35,
               color = "#c0392b", linewidth = 0.75) +
  # Threshold lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = SNOW_EM_THRESH,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = RAIN_EM_THRESH,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.75) +
  # Threshold labels
  annotate("text",
           x = SNOW_EM_THRESH - 0.01, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Snowmelt threshold\n(\u03b1 = %.2f)", SNOW_EM_THRESH),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text",
           x = RAIN_EM_THRESH + 0.01, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf("Rainfall threshold\n(\u03b1 = %.2f)", RAIN_EM_THRESH),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
  # Class region labels
  annotate("text",
           x = SNOW_EM_THRESH / 2, y = 0.15,
           label = "Snowmelt",
           hjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text",
           x = (SNOW_EM_THRESH + RAIN_EM_THRESH) / 2, y = 0.15,
           label = "Rain-on-Snow",
           hjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text",
           x = RAIN_EM_THRESH + (1 - RAIN_EM_THRESH) / 2, y = 0.15,
           label = "Rainfall",
           hjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30") +
  # Axes
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95, 1.0),
    labels = c("0", "0.10", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "0.95", "1.0"),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Rain fraction", y = "Density") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin        = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "rain_frac_threshold_justification.png"),
  plot  = p,
  width = 7,
  height = 4,
  dpi   = 300
)

cat(sprintf("\nFigure saved to:\n  %s\n",
            file.path(out_dir, "rain_frac_threshold_justification.png")))

p

# =============================================================================
# Suggested figure caption (fill in n_peaks and n_sites from console output):
#
# "Figure X. Population-level distribution of rain fraction (rf) for all
# data-sufficient peak-over-threshold events at unregulated Colorado GAGES-II
# sites (n = [n_peaks] events, [n_sites] sites). Rain fraction is defined as
# the ratio of accumulated rainfall flux to total hydrometeorological flux
# (rainfall + snowmelt) over each event's basin-adaptive antecedent window.
# The distribution is strongly bimodal, with modes near rf = 0 (snowmelt-
# dominated events) and rf = 1 (rainfall-dominated events) separated by a
# sparse intermediate region. Dashed vertical lines indicate the end-member
# classification thresholds: events with rf <= 0.10 are classified as
# snowmelt-driven, events with rf >= 0.95 are classified as rainfall-driven,
# and intermediate events are classified as rain-on-snow. Shaded regions
# indicate the candidate threshold ranges evaluated during sensitivity
# analysis; both thresholds fall within low-density zones of the
# distribution, indicating that the classification is robust to small
# perturbations in threshold placement."
# =============================================================================
```
